main jab tak jiyun suhagan jiyun | Main Jab Tak Jiyun Suhagan Jiyun | Maiya Rani Tune Var Diya | Karwa Chauth Special Song | Karva Chauth 2026 Special
karva chauth ke shubh avsar par sunie bhakti aur prem se bhara git “main jab tak jiyun suhagan jiyun ”. suhaginon dvara durga man se vishesh prarthana karte hue apne pati ki lambi aayu ke lie kamna
Karva chauth ka parv pati-patni ke prem, vishvas aur samarpan ka pratik hai. is vishesh avsar par suhagin mahilaen apne pati ki lanbi aayu, sukhi danpaty jivan aur parivar ki khushhali ki kamna karte hue vrat rakhti hain.
